solo.tagline: 9 cards, 9 situations. Which one's a mine?

result.title: Your scorecard
result.toleranceNote: This isn't a test, just a fun look. There are no right or wrong answers.

boundary_guard.name: The Boundary Guard
boundary_guard.desc: You draw clear lines. Your radar is sharp: the moment something feels off, the flag goes up.

silver_lining.name: The Silver-Lining Seeker
silver_lining.desc: You see the good in people first. You're understanding, though asking “is this actually normal?” now and then never hurts.

talk_first.name: The Talk-It-Out Type
talk_first.desc: You don't rush to judge, you'd rather talk first. In gray areas, patience is your superpower.

balanced.name: The Balanced Radar
balanced.desc: Your radar adjusts to the situation: flexible at times, firm at others. A nicely balanced tolerance profile.
